# Five members: all four joiners mint vouchers at once, then join in waves, each member already in
# adding one joiner at a time, so that Alice and Bob add Carol and Dave in the same stretch of
# time. On namenlos, Carol was not in fifteen minutes after this wave.

create alice g
join bob g
join carol g
join dave g
join erin g
run
invite alice g bob
run
state bob g
----
joined

invite alice g carol
invite bob g dave
run
state carol g
----
joined

state dave g
----
joined

invite alice g erin
run
members alice g
----
bob carol dave erin

members bob g
----
alice carol dave erin

members carol g
----
alice bob dave erin

members dave g
----
alice bob carol erin

members erin g
----
alice bob carol dave
